reason: The video describes various tractor attachments and their uses.

tasks.task: Describe the top 10 tractor attachments according to a recent survey.

subtasks.text: Mention the tiller as an attachment that makes it easier to prepare ground for seeding.
Note the hydraulic top link attachment, explaining its benefits for changing angles on attachments.
Describe the ballast box as a solution to increase the front end loader's capability.
Highlight the backhoe as a useful but potentially expensive attachment.
Explain the usefulness of a bucket attachment for various tasks.
Describe the purpose of a quick hitch attachment for easier connection.
Note the importance of a front end loader as a versatile and valuable attachment.
Mention mowers and their various types for cutting fields.
Highlight grapples as attachments with different installation options.
Describe graders as attachments for leveling and resurfacing driveways.
Note palette forks as the top-rated attachment for versatility and ease of use.
